::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Renesas India designs automotive microcontrollers and analog ICs. Part of the Japanese chipmaker's global design network for automotive electronics.
:::

## What does this firm design?

RH850 and RL78 automotive microcontrollers, analog power management ICs, and IoT connectivity solutions.
